text:
maria.k: Hey infra team — noticed a sharp increase in Prometheus scrape latency from node_exporter across GPU nodes right after last night's rolling kernel/security patch. Causing some scrape_timeouts and a cascade of alerts on our SLO dashboard. Anyone else seeing this?

sam.o: Yep, I saw errors in the scrape logs: 
```
Scrape failed: read tcp 10.0.4.12:9090->10.0.8.5:9100: i/o timeout
scrape_duration_seconds{job=\"node-exporter\"} 30.12
```
Looks like some nodes taking >30s to respond.

cheng.li: +1. DCGM exporter also spiked cardinality for per-process GPU metrics after the patch — we now have per-pid labels leaking from kubelet cgroups. That increased payload sizes and pushed some nodes over max_timeouts.

priya.r: Oof. On busy nodes the exporter is doing extra collection and serialization for every container process. We should either throttle scrapes or reduce cardinality.

maria.k: Two short-term mitigations I propose: (1) add a preStop hook + grace period on the node-exporter DaemonSet so draining nodes don't cut exporters mid-scrape, (2) apply a Prometheus metric_relabel_config to drop high-cardinality labels from DCGM metrics for now. Longer term we can fix the exporter behavior. Thoughts?

sam.o: Agree. For #1 we can update DaemonSet with a preStop sleep and a terminationGracePeriod. Example I used elsewhere: 
```
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 15"]
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
```
That gives ongoing scrapes time to finish.

cheng.li: For metric relabeling, we should drop the `pid` and `container_id` labels coming from DCGM and node_exporter process metrics. Something like: 
```
metric_relabel_configs:
- source_labels: ["__name__", "pid"]
  regex: "dcgm_process_gpu_.*;.*"
  action: drop
- regex: "(.*)"
  source_labels: ["container_id"]
  action: labeldrop
```
I'll refine the regex.

ops-oncall: FYI this is impacting the SLO dashboard (gpu-serving / latency P95) because some nodes report stale values and Prometheus returns 500 for queries hitting the slow shards. Customers hitting dedicated clusters saw small blips.

infra-bot: Deploy plan detected: rolling-update node-exporter daemonset v2.1.3 -> v2.1.4 (canary 3 nodes). Scheduled in 10m.

maria.k: Good catch infra-bot. Let's pause that canary until we've applied the preStop/termination change; canary might hit the same issue and make it worse. @cheng.li can you prepare a metric_relabel patch we can hot-patch into prometheus? @sam.o can you prepare the DaemonSet change?

sam.o: On it. I can push a small daemonset patch and annotate nodes to test. Will target BETA cluster first.

cheng.li: I'll add relabels to the scrape_configs for job_name: dcgm-exporter and node-exporter on the Prometheus sidecar. I'll also add a temporary scrape_timeout override to 10s for non-critical exporters so queries don't pile up. Patch: 
```
- job_name: 'dcgm-exporter'
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['pid']
    regex: '.*'
    action: labeldrop
  - source_labels: ['container_id']
    regex: '.*'
    action: labeldrop
```
Note: labeldrop requires Prometheus >=2.21, which we're on.

priya.r: For medium term: we should add a toggle in the DCGM exporter to disable per-process metrics and only expose per-GPU aggregated metrics. There's an open issue upstream. I'll file one and link here.

maria.k: Action items: sam -> DS preStop patch + roll (BETA) (ETA 2h). cheng -> Prometheus relabel + timeout hotpatch (ETA 1h). priya -> upstream issue + proposed flag (ETA EOD). ops-oncall -> monitor SLO and mute noisy alerts until mitigations land.

sam.o: Patch PR: kube/manifests/node-exporter-prestop.yaml -> set lifecycle/preStop and terminationGracePeriodSeconds=40. I'll avoid a full restart by patching the DaemonSet with kubectl patch (rolling will respect the grace).

maria.k: Also let's add a small healthcheck tweak: make the exporter accept a 1s scrape timeout on /metrics if under memory pressure (cheap path). We can add a flag to node-exporter `--collector.timeout=1s` for non-critical collectors.

cheng.li: After relabeling, expect cardinality to drop ~60% on DCGM job and scrape sizes drop accordingly. That should resolve the timeouts. I'll post before/after metrics to this thread.

infra-bot: Prometheus config change applied to staging (hotpatch) by cheng.li at 1798504450.

maria.k: Thanks. ops-oncall please hold alerts for 30m while we watch.

ops-oncall: Muting cpu/gpu_exporter_high_scrape_duration on prod cluster for 30m. Will notify if errors persist.

cheng.li: Quick update: after hotpatch, scrape_duration_seconds for dcgm-exporter dropped from 28s -> 4.2s on average on the 5 noisy nodes. Cardinality reduced (unique series) from ~120k -> ~42k.

sam.o: BETA DaemonSet patched and rolled out. No regressions in the canary nodes. Planning prod roll in 1h.

maria.k: Nice work. Let's keep the longer term items in the infra backlog: (1) exporter config flag to disable per-pid metrics, (2) limit telemetry serialization per-scrape, (3) add graceful shutdown docs for any daemonset exporters. I'll open the tickets.

priya.r: Filed: INFRA-4923 "dcgm: add toggle to disable per-process metrics" with links to our observations.

maria.k: Closing the immediate loop — thanks everyone :thumbsup:. Will follow up with postmortem if prod sees further flakiness.
